_comment: Sketchfab models the game uses, fetched and optimised by fetch.py. Only CC0 / CC BY models go here (they ship in the public repo, credited in game/assets/props/sketchfab/CREDITS.md). Anything under the Sketchfab Standard licence or NC/ND goes in the private pack instead. fit: the axis and real length in metres the model is scaled to.

tee_bench.title: Wooden Park Bench
tee_bench.author: TheMadraver
tee_bench.why: A weathered teak bench as clubs put on their tees. Scaled so the seat is 0.44 m up (it is then a 2.37 m, eight-foot bench with a 1.06 m back, as Lutyens-style teak benches are).

cart_bag.title: Golf Bag
cart_bag.author: mikethornley
cart_bag.why: A cart bag with a full set, as golfers strap on a buggy. 0.95 m bag, the driver's head 1.25 m up; club heads turned to chrome.
